data.name: HALOCLINE
data.detailed_description:
Descend into a drowned world of shipwrecks, forgotten ruins, and abyssal horrors in this deep-sea horror Soulslike. Explore a vast interconnected ocean, master challenging melee combat, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the waves.

  • Explore a Handcrafted Interconnected World

    Journey through windswept shores, shipwrecks, and the abyss below. Discover hidden paths, powerful rewards, and secrets scattered throughout a deeply interconnected world.

  • Master Intense Melee Combat

    Wield a variety of maritime weapons and tools as you battle hostile creatures, corrupted sailors, and abyssal horrors. Dodge, block, parry, and strike with precision to survive the depths.

  • Face the Depths

    The deeper you descend, the darker and more dangerous the ocean becomes. Fight or evade the horrors that lurk below and rely on your lantern to pierce the darkness. Explore three layers of the ocean, from coastal waters to lightless depths inhabited by strange and terrifying lifeforms.

  • Traverse the Unknown

    Use your grappling hook to uncover hidden routes and gain the upper hand in combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

content_descriptors.notes: HALOCLINE contains depictions of realistic blood and violence during combat against hostile creatures and humanoid enemies. Players may encounter disturbing environments, threatening creatures, and horror-themed imagery designed to create tension and fear. The game does not contain sexual content, nudity, or drug use.
